console.vocabularies.lede: Every organisation shares these lists. A change you send waits for someone else to approve it.
console.notFound.body: There is nothing at this address in the console.
console.tenants.title: Tenants
console.tenants.createBody: The tenant gets its roles and its own lists, and its first administrator is invited straight away. It sets its own timezone and languages afterwards.
console.tenants.name: Name
console.tenants.adminEmailHint: Their own work address. Platform staff sign in with separate accounts.
console.tenants.invited: {name} is ready. Its first administrator has been invited.
console.tenants.emptyBody: Create the first tenant and invite its administrator.
console.queue.title: Queue
console.queue.lede: Proposals waiting for a second pair of eyes
console.queue.empty.waiting.title: Nothing waiting
console.queue.empty.waiting.body: Approved and rejected proposals stay under their own tabs.
console.queue.empty.approved.title: Nothing approved yet
console.queue.empty.approved.body: Proposals you approve stay listed here.
console.queue.empty.rejected.title: Nothing rejected yet
console.queue.empty.rejected.body: Proposals you reject stay listed here, with the reason.
console.queue.empty.filtered.title: No proposals match
console.queue.empty.filtered.body: Clear a filter to see more of the queue.
console.queue.detail.notFoundBody: There is no such proposal, or it is one you may not review.
console.queue.detail.scopeUnchanged: This proposal does not change the scope.
console.queue.detail.flagged: Some of this text reads like an instruction to an AI. Check it against the source before you decide. An agent cannot approve it.
console.queue.detail.fourEyes.title: You proposed this.
console.queue.detail.fourEyes.body: Someone else has to approve it.
console.queue.detail.correctedByAgent: The agent {agent} corrected the proposal before applying it.
console.queue.correct.title: Correct before approving
console.queue.correct.hint: Only fields this proposal already sources can be corrected.
console.queue.correct.scopeHint: Add or remove a term this proposal already sources.
console.queue.correct.sourceHint: The https link, or the provision's key, where you read the corrected values.
console.queue.approveHint: Writes the version, the audit entry and the re-index at once. Your passkey will be asked.
console.queue.rejectDialog.title: Reject this proposal
console.queue.rejectDialog.notePlacehold: e.g. The excerpt is from the consultation draft, not the adopted text
console.queue.rejectDialog.hint: Goes back to the agent run and the problem report, if one started it.
console.evaluation.title: Evaluation
console.evaluation.lede: The questions search is scored against, the scores it is held to, and how each recorded run went.
console.evaluation.errorTitle: Could not load the evaluation set
console.evaluation.metric.label: Metric
console.evaluation.baseline.title: Release gate baseline
console.evaluation.baseline.notRecorded: Nobody has recorded a baseline yet, so no build fails on these scores.
console.evaluation.baseline.recordedOn: Recorded {date}. A build that drops below it fails.
console.evaluation.gate.notInGate: Not yet in the release gate
console.evaluation.questions.title: Questions
console.evaluation.questions.emptyBody: Add a question search should answer, with the records a good answer contains.
console.evaluation.runs.title: Past runs
console.evaluation.runs.emptyBody: The release gate scores search in every build either way. A recorded run shows here with its scores.
console.evaluation.add.title: Add a question
console.evaluation.add.notInGate: Not yet in the release gate. Recorded runs score it straight away; a build fails on it only once it is written to the gate's file and shipped.
console.evaluation.add.keyHint: Never changes. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
console.evaluation.add.langRequired: Choose the language it is asked in.
console.evaluation.add.question: Question
console.evaluation.add.questionHint: Exactly what a reader would type into search.
console.evaluation.add.expectedHint: The stable keys a good answer contains, one per line. Leave it empty when search should find nothing.
console.evaluation.add.matchKindHint: Which part of search should win it.
console.evaluation.add.asOfHint: Optional. The legal date it is asked on.
console.evaluation.add.notes: Why it is in the set
console.evaluation.add.notesHint: For the next person who reads it. Never a bank's own text.
console.evaluation.add.duplicateKey: The set already has a question with that key. Keys are never reused.
console.evaluation.add.added: Added {key}. It is not yet in the release gate.
